READ_TOOLS.name: list_files
READ_TOOLS.description: List files and folders in a directory of the project.

path.description: Directory relative to the project root. Default '.'

depth.description: How many levels to show (1-4). Default 2

READ_TOOLS.name: read_file
READ_TOOLS.description: Read a text file. Output lines are prefixed with 'N| ' line numbers.

path.description: File path relative to the project root

offset.description: First line to read, starting at 1

READ_TOOLS.name: glob_files
READ_TOOLS.description: Find files by glob pattern such as '**/*.py' or 'src/**/*.ts'.

pattern.description: Glob pattern relative to the project root

READ_TOOLS.name: grep_files
READ_TOOLS.description: Search file contents with a regular expression.

path.description: Directory or file to search. Default '.'

include.description: Only search file names matching this glob, e.g. '*.py'

READ_TOOLS.name: todo_write
READ_TOOLS.description: Create or update the task checklist for the current job.

WRITE_TOOLS.name: edit_file
WRITE_TOOLS.description: Replace exact text in a file. old_string must match the file exactly and be unique unless replace_all is true. Use an empty old_string only to create a new file.

path.description: File path relative to the project root

what.description: Brief description of what was changed (1-2 lines, optional)

WRITE_TOOLS.name: write_file
WRITE_TOOLS.description: Create a file or completely overwrite an existing one.

path.description: File path relative to the project root

what.description: Brief description of what the file contains or does (1-2 lines, optional)

WRITE_TOOLS.name: delete_file
WRITE_TOOLS.description: Delete a file from the project.

path.description: File path relative to the project root

what.description: Brief description of what was deleted (1-2 lines, optional)

WRITE_TOOLS.name: run_command
WRITE_TOOLS.description: Run a shell command in the project root (build, test, git, install, etc.).

WRITE_TOOLS.name: web_fetch
WRITE_TOOLS.description: Fetch a web page and return its text content.

IMAGE_READ_TOOLS.name: image_read
IMAGE_READ_TOOLS.description: Read and analyze an image file using Pillow metadata and Gemini Vision.

path.description: Image path relative to project root

prompt.description: Question or analysis instruction for the image

IMAGE_READ_TOOLS.name: image_ocr
IMAGE_READ_TOOLS.description: Extract all text, tables, and labels from an image using Gemini Vision OCR.

path.description: Image path relative to project root

IMAGE_WRITE_TOOLS.name: image_generate_uhd
IMAGE_WRITE_TOOLS.description: Generate an Ultra HD 4K (3840x2160) image from a prompt and save it to disk.

prompt.description: Detailed visual description of the image to generate

enhance.description: Apply Ultra HD Lanczos sharpening and contrast mastering. Default true

what.description: Brief description of the generated image (1-2 lines, optional)

IMAGE_WRITE_TOOLS.name: image_transform
IMAGE_WRITE_TOOLS.description: Resize, crop, rotate, convert format, or enhance an existing image.

output_path.description: Output image path (optional, defaults to overwriting path)

what.description: Brief description of the transformation (1-2 lines, optional)

DOCX_READ_TOOLS.name: docx_read
DOCX_READ_TOOLS.description: Read a Microsoft Word (.docx) file including headings, paragraphs, and tables.

include_tables.description: Include extracted table rows. Default true

DOCX_READ_TOOLS.name: docx_analyze
DOCX_READ_TOOLS.description: Analyze a Word (.docx) file for structure, statistics, styles, headings, and readability.

DOCX_WRITE_TOOLS.name: docx_write
DOCX_WRITE_TOOLS.description: Create or overwrite a Microsoft Word (.docx) document from Markdown-formatted content.

content.description: Body content supporting # headings, * bullets, 1. numbered lists, and | tables |

what.description: Brief description of the document content (1-2 lines, optional)

DOCX_WRITE_TOOLS.name: docx_edit
DOCX_WRITE_TOOLS.description: Edit an existing .docx file by replacing text across paragraphs/tables or appending content.

find_text.description: Exact text to find and replace (optional)

append_markdown.description: Additional Markdown paragraphs/headings to append at the end (optional)

what.description: Brief description of the edit (1-2 lines, optional)

EXCEL_READ_TOOLS.name: excel_read
EXCEL_READ_TOOLS.description: Read sheets, rows, and cell values from an Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file.

sheet.description: Sheet name (optional, defaults to active sheet)

EXCEL_READ_TOOLS.name: excel_analyze
EXCEL_READ_TOOLS.description: Analyze an Excel (.xlsx) workbook for sheet schemas, summary statistics, missing values, and formulas.

EXCEL_WRITE_TOOLS.name: excel_write
EXCEL_WRITE_TOOLS.description: Create or update an Excel (.xlsx) workbook with headers, rows, formulas, and auto-sized columns.

rows.description: 2D array of row values (strings, numbers, or '=SUM(...)' formulas)

PDF_PPTX_READ_TOOLS.name: pdf_read
PDF_PPTX_READ_TOOLS.description: Read text content from a PDF file across specified pages.

PDF_PPTX_READ_TOOLS.name: pdf_analyze
PDF_PPTX_READ_TOOLS.description: Analyze a PDF document for metadata, page count, word density, TOC, and structure.

PDF_PPTX_READ_TOOLS.name: pptx_read
PDF_PPTX_READ_TOOLS.description: Read slide titles, bullet text, tables, and speaker notes from a PowerPoint (.pptx) file.

PDF_PPTX_WRITE_TOOLS.name: pdf_write
PDF_PPTX_WRITE_TOOLS.description: Generate a formatted PDF document from title and Markdown/plain text content.

content.description: Full text/Markdown content to render into PDF pages

PDF_PPTX_WRITE_TOOLS.name: pptx_write
PDF_PPTX_WRITE_TOOLS.description: Create a PowerPoint (.pptx) presentation deck from a list of slide definitions.

VOICE_READ_TOOLS.name: voice_analyze
VOICE_READ_TOOLS.description: Analyze an audio/voice file (.wav, .mp3, .m4a, .ogg, .flac) for acoustic metrics and Gemini AI voice comprehension.

prompt.description: Specific question or analysis focus for the audio

VOICE_READ_TOOLS.name: voice_transcribe
VOICE_READ_TOOLS.description: Transcribe spoken audio into accurate text and speaker segments.

language.description: Language code hint, e.g. 'en-US' or 'tl-PH'. Default 'auto'

VOICE_WRITE_TOOLS.name: voice_generate
VOICE_WRITE_TOOLS.description: Generate natural spoken audio (.mp3 or .wav) from text using Neural TTS / offline TTS.

voice.description: Voice name or gender hint, e.g. 'en-US-GuyNeural', 'en-US-JennyNeural', 'en-PH-JamesNeural'

VIDEO_READ_TOOLS.name: video_read
VIDEO_READ_TOOLS.description: Inspect a video file (.mp4, .mkv, .mov, .avi, .webm) for resolution, FPS, frame count, duration, and timeline info.

VIDEO_READ_TOOLS.name: video_analyze
VIDEO_READ_TOOLS.description: Extract keyframes from a video file and analyze visual scenes, actions, and text with Gemini Vision.

prompt.description: What to analyze or look for in the video

sample_frames.description: Number of evenly spaced frames to sample (2-12). Default 6

VIDEO_WRITE_TOOLS.name: video_extract_frames
VIDEO_WRITE_TOOLS.description: Extract keyframe images from a video file into an output folder.

output_dir.description: Directory to save extracted frame PNGs

count.description: Number of evenly spaced frames to extract (1-30). Default 8

DATA_UTIL_READ_TOOLS.name: sqlite_query
DATA_UTIL_READ_TOOLS.description: Run a SQL query on a local SQLite database file and return rows.

sql.description: SQL query to execute (SELECT, PRAGMA, etc.)

DATA_UTIL_READ_TOOLS.name: csv_analyze
DATA_UTIL_READ_TOOLS.description: Perform statistical and schema profiling on a CSV/TSV dataset.

DATA_UTIL_READ_TOOLS.name: system_diagnostics
DATA_UTIL_READ_TOOLS.description: Inspect OS, CPU, RAM, Disk, Python .venv packages, and Gemibot readiness.

DATA_UTIL_WRITE_TOOLS.name: archive_manage
DATA_UTIL_WRITE_TOOLS.description: Create or extract a .zip or .tar.gz archive inside the project.

destination.description: Destination archive path or extraction folder

DATA_UTIL_WRITE_TOOLS.name: qr_generate
DATA_UTIL_WRITE_TOOLS.description: Generate a high-resolution QR code image PNG from text or URL.

data.description: URL or text payload for the QR code

GROUNDING_TOOLS.name: search_grounding
GROUNDING_TOOLS.description: Real-time Google Search grounding: query Google for live facts, breaking news, docs, and citations.

query.description: Search query to find real-time information from Google Search

GROUNDING_TOOLS.name: map_grounding
GROUNDING_TOOLS.description: Google Maps grounding: look up places, addresses, navigation directions, geo coordinates, and local business data.

location.description: Place name, address, or geographic query on Google Maps

query.description: Specific question or information required about this location (optional)
